extraction.Name: Louis Valandra
extraction.Occupation/Income: By the sale of groceries and so forth and by farming.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was mailed to allottee; signed receipt for patent; no application made for patent; no debts settled with purchaser at time of sale; consideration paid in cash; land sold for $6500.00; has three children and a wife; satisfied with the sale; document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 13, 1929.
